architecture.summary: Test only, hardening. The OPERATION_CAPACITY=2 case of test/integration/mcp/hosted-tenant-composition.test.ts counted raw relay deliveries, as the tenant capacity case did before #302. The tenant sends a relay again when its answer comes after the 5 s limit of an audit send, and the relay route of the control plane keeps one event for each operation ID (AcceptedRelays), so a repeated delivery is expected behavior. The case now waits for three operations and compares their statuses; the context and path checks stay on each delivery. No repeated delivery was reproduced in this case: its relay request is written only after the pipelines end. docs/testing/test-list.md describes the count. No source, support, configuration, workflow, dependency, or Mermaid block changes, so no component, edge, public module, declaration, or runtime behavior changes, and the registry stays accurate.
